_doc: First-time Career Mode tutorial pages (skippable; replay from the Career menu). 'visual' picks a small built-in illustration: loop, choice, stats, kick, road.

pages.title: Week by Week
pages.body: A career moves one week at a time. Start each week on the Hub, handle what happens off the field, check how you feel on game day, then kick. Your results feed back into everything. The game saves every week.

pages.title: Choices Matter
pages.body: Each week brings one or two situations: parties, exams, extra practice, a friend who needs a ride. Every choice shows exactly what it changes, including how you'll feel on game day.

pages.title: Four Kinds of Stats
pages.body: Life stats are your day-to-day: keep them above 40 or they start to hurt. Football stats make kicks easier. Personality grows slowly and unlocks traits with small bonuses and new scenarios.

pages.title: How You Feel Is How You Kick
pages.body: Before every game, the Outlook shows what's helping and hurting: tired legs cost power, nerves add wobble, a warmup on the sideline net steadies you. Same swipe, different kick.

pages.title: The Road to the Pros
pages.body: Kick well, win games and keep your grades up to get recruited. College builds your draft stock. In the pros, every season you have to earn your spot. Rough patches have fallback routes, but a long run of them ends a career.
